title: Neovim Crashed with SigAbrt

labels.name: bug-crash
labels.description: issue reporting a crash or segfault

milestone.title: backlog
milestone.description: Low priority items. We plan to work on this but don't have a target date.

body:
### Neovim version (nvim -v)

v0.6.0-dev+220-gdb695cc4c

### Vim (not Nvim) behaves the same?

not tried, due to lua plugins

### Operating system/version

ubuntu 20.04

### Terminal name/version

kitty 0.15.0

### $TERM environment variable

xterm-kitty

### Installation

build from repo

### How to reproduce the issue

This seems to be a data condition. On my machine I do the following

1. `cd ~/.config/nvim`
2. nvim lua/plugins/init.lua

Neovim will crash right at the startup.

If I remove/reorder some plugins it sometimes also crashed with
opening the top-level `init.lua` or my `lua/settings.lua`.

In the current configuration I have the following plugins loaded (and their dependencies):

```
wbthomason/packer.nvim
RRethy/nvim-base16
folke/tokyonight.nvim
kyazdani42/nvim-tree.lua
kyazdani42/nvim-web-devicons
ojroques/nvim-bufdel
lewis6991/gitsigns.nvim
TimUntersberger/neogit
nvim-lua/plenary.nvim
```

Whenever I remove any of those plugins neovim doesn't crash anymore.

### Expected behavior

Neovim shouldn't crash.

### Actual behavior

Neovim crashes with SigAbrt.
